fields.sections.0.h: Disclosing Mathematical Achievements of Internal Latest Models
fields.sections.1.h: Establishing Public Disclosure Standards Through Collaboration with Institute for Advanced Study Advisory Panel
fields.sections.2.h: Building Public Platforms and Citation & Verification Protocols
fields.sections.3.h: Formalizing Proof Code in Programming Language and Enhancing Reproducibility
fields.sections.4.h: Disclosing Metadata and Computational Volume for Enhanced Transparency
fields.sections.5.h: Plans to Support Academia for Mathematical Advancement
fields.sections.6.h: Enhancing Scientist Capabilities and Responsible Model Disclosure
fields.sections.0.ko: OpenAI announced it will disclose extensive mathematical research results produced by its internally developed latest frontier model. This is not merely a technical showcase but an intentional choice for better collaboration with the mathematics community.
fields.sections.1.ko: OpenAI consulted with the 'Mathematics and AI Advisory Panel,' an independent advisory body under the Institute for Advanced Study, to develop best practices for result disclosure. By reflecting expert academic opinion, it seeks to secure both transparency and credibility.
fields.sections.2.ko: Results are disclosed through a GitHub repository with clear guidelines on paper revision and citation methods. Additional community-based platforms are under review, and plans are in place to continuously improve paper quality through enhanced citation and mathematical explanation.
fields.sections.3.ko: Many proofs have been formalized in a programming language called Lean, enabling computers to automatically verify mathematical proofs. The repository will be continuously updated with new formalization results, substantially enhancing result reproducibility and credibility.
fields.sections.4.ko: For scientific transparency, the model will disclose 10 summaries of reasoning processes, estimates of computational volume by ChatGPT Pro usage standards, and statistics on attempted problems. On average, each result consumed computational volume equivalent to approximately 3 hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking capacity.
fields.sections.5.ko: OpenAI plans to support workshops, academic conferences, and special programs to promote understanding of major AI-generated results. This demonstrates a commitment to advancing AI mathematical progress as a contribution to expanding the frontier of human knowledge.
fields.sections.6.ko: OpenAI will responsibly disclose the model that produced these results to directly provide scientists with cutting-edge capabilities. To this end, it will continuously evaluate the mathematics and science performance of internal frontier models and incorporate community feedback to improve future standards for disclosing scientific achievements.
fields.caveat: The mathematical validity of disclosed results and their actual impact on the existing mathematics community were not specifically evaluated in the source text. Beyond the source's claims regarding disclosure methods and transparency, independent verification of substantive contribution is necessary.
